$comment: Curated running order for the in-app guide. Hand-ordered rather than generated, because alphabetical is not a reading order: concepts belong before configuration, and troubleshooting last. Adding a page means dropping the .md into docs/user-guide and adding an entry here; the build copies the folder wholesale. 'file' is relative to wwwroot/guide/.
